text: Phantom Thief on a Mischievous Night
The fake Jacky, Olant, and Potumkin showed up in\nPhantom Wisp's hideout! Get 3 keys from them to catch\nPhantom Wisp!
You got 3 keys from the monsters disguising themselves as\nJacky, Olant, and Potumkin! Open the door and go to where\nPhantom Wisp is!
Phantom Wisp set up another trick and disappeared.\nPick the right answer for the riddle in each of the\n4 rooms to reach Phantom Wisp!
Finally you managed to corner Phantom Wisp!\nWin against her to retrieve the items stolen from Zarth\nand the others!
